# Constellation standards (vendored)

<!-- Generated by the constellation's operations/scripts/sync-standards.sh — do not edit. -->

This directory holds read-only copies of the constellation engineering standards this
repository adopts, vendored from the constellation umbrella's docs/standards/ at a pinned commit.

**Read-only: never edit these files.** `check.sh` verifies them against `SHA256SUMS` and
fails CI on any edit; changes come only from a re-sync.

| Standard | Version | Title | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| STD-01 | 2 | CLI surface — command grammar, inputs and effects, output modes, errors, help, and golden-tested public surfaces | [STD-01-cli-surface/STD-01.md](STD-01-cli-surface/STD-01.md) |
| STD-02 | 4 | Rust architecture and errors — layering, visibility, typed errors, failure semantics, idiom and naming, logging, and test layout for constellation Rust projects | [STD-02-rust-architecture-and-errors/STD-02.md](STD-02-rust-architecture-and-errors/STD-02.md) |
| STD-03 | 2 | Concurrency and process safety — locks, channels, durable writes, state evolution, subprocess lifecycles, destructive operations, remote effects, test containment and resource bounds | [STD-03-concurrency-and-process-safety/STD-03.md](STD-03-concurrency-and-process-safety/STD-03.md) |
| STD-04 | 2 | Testing and verification — test design, hermetic tests, honest gates, docs as contracts, and evidence-based verification conduct | [STD-04-testing-and-verification/STD-04.md](STD-04-testing-and-verification/STD-04.md) |
| STD-05 | 1 | Security boundaries — authority, filesystem containment, child environments, redaction, local network surfaces, supply chain and consent | [STD-05-security-boundaries/STD-05.md](STD-05-security-boundaries/STD-05.md) |
| STD-06 | 1 | Design docs and feature tracking — one folder per feature, a delivery stage separate from doc approval, a generated feature board, admitted decisions, and tasks tagged with their feature | [STD-06-design-docs-and-feature-tracking/STD-06.md](STD-06-design-docs-and-feature-tracking/STD-06.md) |
| STD-07 | 1 | UI and UX — consistent spacing, shared edges, one type scale, minimal words, show each thing once, honest charts, stable layouts, visible state | [STD-07-ui-ux/STD-07.md](STD-07-ui-ux/STD-07.md) |

Each standard is a directory. `STD-nn.md` holds its rules, where they apply and how to
deviate: read it first. `why.md` explains each rule, `checks.md` names the gate that
enforces it, `exemplars.md` points at worked examples in Orbit, and `CHANGELOG.md`
records its versions.

Source: the constellation umbrella `docs/standards/` at commit `af854b0e869a4783b46e323eca30c7034307a4ad`.

## Normative

The adopted standards are normative: follow them. Cite a rule as `STD-nn §Rn`; reviewers
check every change against them and report violations as `STD-nn §Rn` with file:line evidence.

## Deviations

To depart from a rule, record a decision in this repository's own
`docs/design/<feature>/4_decisions.md` citing `STD-nn@<version> §Rn` (for example
`STD-01@1 §R3`) with the rationale. Never edit the vendored copies to deviate.

## Integrity check

`sh docs/standards/check.sh` (run it in CI) verifies every file here against `SHA256SUMS` and
that the repository-root `AGENTS.md` carries the managed `constellation-standards` block.

## Re-sync

From the constellation umbrella checkout:

    # re-sync the adopted set to canon HEAD
    operations/scripts/sync-standards.sh <path-to-this-repo>
    # change the adopted set
    operations/scripts/sync-standards.sh --adopt STD-01,STD-02 <path-to-this-repo>
    # verify, and warn when the vendored versions are behind the canon
    operations/scripts/sync-standards.sh --check <path-to-this-repo>
